scope: Dedicated external R1 reset-epoch acknowledgement plus lossless named-status serialization for safe startup and empty-session retirement only; no controller, CDC, physical FIFO, timing, PPA, model/GPU, new A4 DSE, or RTL correctness claim.

implemented_composition.r2_retirement_behavior: blocks new candidate acceptance while retaining drain of already accepted candidates and responses
implemented_composition.r1_drain_ordering: collector permits R1 drain only after R2 payload and descriptor drain facts are delivered
implemented_composition.retirement_scope: safe empty-session retirement; R3 publication, source/R4 completion, and R5 reclaim remain later I2-I4 work
